proposal.hypothesis: Factoring the final permutation lookups into two reused z-offset table bases may reduce repeated index additions/address work across the eight scalar corner hashes. This changes hash addressing only; the compiler may already perform equivalent factoring, so compare against the selected hash-prefix-factored parent and retain the original baseline as the campaign anchor without presuming a speedup.

retained: In Noise, create two const pointers to the permutation table at iz and iz+1, then use the existing pxy prefixes as indices for the eight final corner hashes.

Replace the repeated final lookup indices pxy + iz and pxy + iz + 1 with equivalent accesses through the two shared bases; leave gradient selection, interpolation, octave control flow, table contents, and pixel traversal unchanged.
